name: MinIO Enterprise / Local
tagline: High-performance self-hosted or enterprise S3 object storage server.

instructions.navBreadcrumb: MinIO Console › Access Keys › Create Access Key
instructions.step1: Open your MinIO web console and log in with your administrative credentials.
instructions.step2: Go to Access Keys, create a new key pair, and copy the Access Key and Secret Key.
instructions.step3: Enter your MinIO server S3 API endpoint (e.g. http://localhost:9000 or custom domain).

fields.label: MinIO Server API Endpoint
fields.helper: URL of your MinIO server API (e.g. http://localhost:9000, https://s3.mycompany.com)

fields.label: Bucket Name (Optional)
fields.helper: Target bucket name (leave empty to mount all buckets)

fields.label: Root User / Access Key
fields.helper: MinIO Access Key or Root User

fields.label: Root Password / Secret Key
fields.helper: MinIO Secret Key or Root Password
